---
title: "About this edition"
---

This is a living public edition of the handbook. The complete handbook is available to use now, and it will continue to be corrected and improved as evidence, policies, technology and reader needs change.

## What you can expect

- all 36 chapters are available;
- the handbook includes 53 checklists, decision aids and templates;
- sources are linked to the claims they support;
- local or time-sensitive requirements are labelled for checking;
- corrections and useful additions can enter the documented editorial process; and
- navigation, links, citations and page coverage are checked when the book is built.

## What this does not mean

No online handbook is permanently complete or universally applicable. Policies, software, evidence and institutional arrangements change. General guidance cannot replace the rules, approvals or specialist advice that govern your particular work.

## Help improve it

If something is missing, unclear, incorrect or no longer useful, you can [suggest an improvement](contributions/index.qmd). Suggestions are reviewed before any change is published.

## Project records

For readers who want the underlying quality records, the project maintains a [`requirements register`](https://github.com/hareshsuppiah/handbook-for-the-recently-enrolled/blob/main/planning/requirements-checklist.csv) and a [`release verification record`](https://github.com/hareshsuppiah/handbook-for-the-recently-enrolled/blob/main/planning/release-verification-2026-08-28.md).
